recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Any future terminology refinement should be handled as a new OO value-set maintenance issue rather than reopening this applied reconciliation.
issue_request: FHIR-45064 was Applied/Persuasive for R6 after OO agreed to review and realign overlapping/confusing value sets across NutritionIntake and NutritionProduct.
initial_application: The realignment appears in existing history: a3233204b1 changed nutrition value-set composition and resource terminology, 3731dbe4d5 and a218cee747 refined the value-set descriptions and inclusions, and 05e646d74bb93a1c435d884747dc64da94898435 explicitly cited FHIR-45064 in a later NutritionIntake cleanup commit.
additional_context: Active fhir.ini entries keep NutritionIntake and NutritionProduct in the current build. Current bindings distinguish NutritionIntake.code/diet-type, NutritionIntake.nutritionItem.type/food-type, NutritionIntake.nutritionItem.nutritionProduct and NutritionProduct.code/edible-substance-type, and NutritionProduct.category/nutrition-product-category. OO minutes confirm the approval and no Zulip conflict was found.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The shared edible-substance-type binding between the NutritionIntake inline product code and NutritionProduct.code is intentional semantic alignment for the same product-code concept, while product category and item type now have distinct definitions and compositions.
